# Changelog 0.0.1246

## Changes since v0.0.1242

- A project's sources compile in any order, whatever imports and usings each one starts with (#2378) (#2383) (`3bf856d1`)
- RetroSharp.Tool ships its own NuGet README with the .NET 10 requirement and no broken links (#2379) (#2382) (`b47e4fe2`)
- A constant Tilemap.Set outside the setup writes its cell when it runs (#2374) (#2381) (`c90ddbd2`)
- Tilemap.Set and Fill take the tile's number in the scene's tileset (#2368) (#2377) (`64a99848`)
